reset_baseline.claim_limit: Documented module-reset defaults, not a claim that CR.EN disable alone restores them or proves global bus idle. For L010/L011 DR is on the second control page; for other classic versions DR and STAT share the second control page.

async_master.reset_programming_sequence: Enable own gate; write own APBRST field 0 then1; configure BRR; enable BRREN; enable CR.EN. Confirm reset assertion/release and local reset defaults before new configuration. This is a per-controller reset, not proof of physical bus-free timing.
protocol_limits: SI holds ordinary progress until software prepares the next action and clears it; this does not exclude external bus-error transitions.
Master STOP completes by hardware clearing STO without an SI interrupt. F8 is also transient and is not proof of global bus idle or ownership.
Arbitration loss retires without requesting a new STOP. Writing STO=0 has no effect on a retained STOP.
EN=0 then EN=1 then SI=0 is the own-manual stubborn-bus-error recovery. Arbitrary disable is not a documented internal reset or wire-recovery guarantee.
Checked, exclusive APBRST assertion/release and module-default readback support local reinitialization only; no electrical bus-free, target-recovery or multi-master guarantee is claimed.
